def_en: 2) to cry out, shout for joy, give a ringing cry
2a1) to give a ringing cry (in joy, exaltation, distress)
2a2) to cry aloud (in summons, exhortation of wisdom)
2b) (Piel) to give a ringing cry (in joy, exultation, praise
2d) (Hiphil) to cause to ring or sing out (for joy)
kjv: aloud for joy, cry out, be joyful (greatly, make to) rejoice, (cause to) shout (for joy), (cause to) sing (aloud, for joy, out), triumph.
expl: properly, to creak (or emit a stridulous sound), i.e. to shout (usually for joy)
